aboutGame.title: What is Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea?
paragraphs: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is a stylized fighting RPG on Roblox inspired by the Bleach anime universe. Choose from three playable races Shinigami, Quincy, or Hollow each with unique progression systems, unlockable abilities, and evolution paths. Master over 130 skills as you fight your way to the level 100 cap.

Whether you're unlocking your first Shikai, evolving from a base Hollow into an Arrancar, or grinding Quincy Lieutenant missions, our wiki covers every system with detailed guides, data tables, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea.

items.question: What is Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea?
items.answer: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is a free-to-play fighting RPG on Roblox based on the Bleach anime. You choose one of game mechanics Shinigami (Soul Reaper), Quincy, or Hollow each with unique progression, combat abilities, and evolution systems. The game features 130+ skills, a level 100 cap, boss fights, and deep build customization.

items.question: Which race should beginners pick?
items.answer: Shinigami is the most straightforward starter race, while Hollow and Quincy offer more specialized progression routes. Compare their abilities before committing.

items.question: What is the current level cap?
items.answer: The current level cap is 100, with more than 130 skills available across trees and race progression systems.

items.question: Where do I find active codes?
items.answer: Use the Codes page for working codes, rewards, expiration notes, and redeem instructions.

items.question: Are boss guides updated?
items.answer: Boss pages are organized with spawn notes, attack patterns, strategies, drop tables, and related next steps for progression.

bosses.overviewDescription: Complete guides for every boss encounter in Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea 13 bosses from the tutorial knight Gelum to endgame encounters like the Gelid Dweller and Gauntlet challenges.
bosses.body: Bosses in Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea serve as skill gates and progression milestones. Some, like Gelum, teach you the combat fundamentals during the tutorial. Others, such as the Shikai Spirit and Resurreccion Spirit, are inner-world encounters tied directly to your race's power unlock. Area bosses like Dragonfly, King Croc, and Securis guard access to new zones and rewards. Recent additions include the Rogue Commander with his Minions, the ice-themed The Everfrosted, and four brand new endgame bosses: The Gelid Dweller, Cinder of the Broken Sky, Devourer of Hosts, and the Wandering Swordsman (Junichiro). Each boss has distinct attack patterns and telegraphed moves you need to learn. Use the guides below to prepare for every fight.
